FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 16
Committee: Ethics and Campaign Finance Sponsor: Representative Lamb
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 01/27/2026
House Bill 16 as introduced would reduce the expenses of the Secretary of State's office by an
office-estimated $10,000 per year by providing for the Secretary to send notifications regarding
civil penalties by certified mail only when the imposed penalty exceeds the cost of certified
mail.
